usageNote: 日常口语短语，表示一个习惯性行为，never让语气超级坚定，就是'打死都不带'的感觉！

examples.en: I never take my phone to school because the teacher will confiscate it.
examples.zh: 我从不把手机带去学校，因为老师会没收它。

examples.en: She said she would never take her phone to school after losing it last time.
examples.zh: 她说上次丢了手机后，再也不会把手机带去学校了。
